column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 12 (M24012): AR Team membersihkan fantom Nirvana; Ateraxis
# menyadari dirinya harus membuang "dirinya sendiri" untuk diterima Nirvana.
# Tetap Inggris: Soppo, Robella, Beluga, Asteria, M4, M4A1, M16, RO, AR-15, AR Team,
# Avenger's Mark, Mark of the Avenger, Nirvana, Ateraxis, Chiloveig, Lunasia, Caldwell,
# Mother, Boojum, Doll, Frame, Commander, Reverse Collapse, Holy Grail.
Heehahaha! The carnival has begun! Let me make you all look a little prettier~
column2: Hihahaha! Karnavalnya dimulai! Biar kupercantik kalian sedikit~

column1: (Soppo charged like a sharp arrow towards the shadows wandering in Nirvana, her sharp claws and fangs easily tearing the twisted monsters to shreds.)
column2: (Soppo menerjang seperti anak panah tajam ke arah bayangan yang berkeliaran di Nirvana, cakar dan giginya yang tajam dengan mudah mencabik monster-monster bengkok itu jadi serpihan.)

column1: (Accompanied by excited laughter, Soppo plunged directly into the dense cluster of phantoms like a grenade fired from a barrel.)
column2: (Disertai tawa penuh semangat, Soppo langsung menerjun ke gerombolan fantom yang rapat itu seperti granat yang ditembakkan dari laras.)

column1: (She completely ignored any standard tactical movements, holding her rifle with one hand and spraying a hail of bullets like a gale sweeping away fallen leaves.)
column2: (Dia sepenuhnya mengabaikan gerakan taktis standar, memegang senapannya dengan satu tangan dan menyemburkan hujan proyektil seperti angin kencang yang menyapu daun kering.)

column1: (Even running out of bullets couldn't stop her. She directly swung her specially reinforced mechanical claws, forcefully tearing a twisted phantom that tried to pounce on her in half.)
column2: (Kehabisan amunisi pun tidak menghentikannya. Dia langsung mengayunkan cakar mekanisnya yang diperkuat khusus, memaksa satu fantom bengkok yang mencoba menerjangnya terbelah dua.)

column1: (This was pure violence, a flesh and blood feast belonging to a berserker.)
column2: (Itu kekerasan murni, pesta darah dan daging milik seorang berserker.)

column1: Heehahahaha.
column2: Hihahahaha.

column1: (The remnants of the phenomenon, which should have been irrational and acting only on instinct, actually showed a bizarre moment of stagnation and retreat when faced with Soppo's terrifying offensive, which was more monster-like than the monsters themselves.)
column2: (Sisa-sisa fenomena yang seharusnya tanpa nalar dan hanya bergerak dengan insting itu justru menunjukkan momen ganjil berupa jeda dan langkah mundur saat menghadapi serangan Soppo yang mengerikan, yang lebih monster daripada monster itu sendiri.)

column1: What are you spacing out for! Who's next!
column2: Kenapa bengong! Siapa berikutnya!

column1: (However, this wide-open and wild combat style was destined to be accompanied by extremely high risks. Soppo, pushing deep alone, was soon cut off by a tide of phantoms and fell into a heavy encirclement.)
column2: (Namun gaya tempur yang terbuka lebar dan liar itu sudah ditakdirkan disertai risiko yang sangat tinggi. Soppo yang menerobos dalam sendirian tak lama diputus oleh pasang fantom dan jatuh ke kepungan yang berat.)

column1: (Just as the phantoms' claws were about to reach her blind spot—a faint blue glow turned into fluttering butterflies, blocking the attack for Soppo.)
column2: (Tepat saat cakar para fantom hampir mencapai titik butanya—kilau biru samar berubah menjadi kupu-kupu yang beterbangan, menahan serangan itu untuk Soppo.)

column1: (At the same time, accompanied by a burst of high-frequency electronic noise, a black and yellow figure cut into the battlefield from an extremely tricky angle, fighting back-to-back with Soppo.)
column2: (Pada waktu yang sama, disertai semburan derau elektronik berfrekuensi tinggi, sebuah figur hitam-kuning menyelip masuk ke medan tempur dari sudut yang sangat licik, bertarung punggung-ke-punggung dengan Soppo.)

column1: Soppo, control your emotions. Pay attention to your blind spots.
column2: Soppo, kendalikan emosimu. Perhatikan titik butamu.

column1: Because everyone is here this time, I just need to keep charging forward and clear the way for everyone.
column2: Karena kali ini semuanya ada di sini, aku cuma perlu terus menerjang ke depan dan membuka jalan untuk semuanya.

column1: Hm? A message from the Commander... Ah! I get it, it's that big guy, right.
column2: Hm? Pesan dari Commander... Ah! Aku paham, yang besar itu kan.

column1: Robella, I'll leave the surrounding enemies to you.
column2: Robella, kuserahkan musuh di sekitar padamu.

column1: Agh... seriously, always acting so recklessly!
column2: Aduh... yang benar saja, selalu bertindak segegabah itu!

column1: (Robella sighs helplessly, but her body steps in front of Soppo without hesitation. The two of them turn into a sharp knife, forcibly tearing a gap through the swarm of phantoms.)
column2: (Robella mengembuskan napas tak berdaya, tapi tubuhnya melangkah ke depan Soppo tanpa ragu. Keduanya berubah menjadi belati tajam, memaksa terbuka satu celah di kawanan fantom itu.)

column1: (In stark contrast to their storm-like assault, on the other side of the defense line are Beluga and Asteria, who are eager to utilize every single bullet and tactical movement to the absolute limit.)
column2: (Berbeda tajam dari serbuan mereka yang seperti badai, di sisi lain garis pertahanan ada Beluga dan Asteria yang ingin memanfaatkan setiap butir proyektil dan setiap gerakan taktis sampai batas mutlaknya.)

column1: Whoa, our crazy girl has already charged out that far.
column2: Wah, si gadis gila kita sudah menerjang sejauh itu.

column1: If you're worried, you can just follow her.
column2: Kalau khawatir, kau bisa menyusulnya saja.

column1: She doesn't need me to worry about her anymore, not to mention she has Robella assisting her.
column2: Dia tidak butuh aku mengkhawatirkannya lagi, apalagi ada Robella yang membantunya.

column1: Oh? New orders are here... This combat approach... really trusts our capabilities.
column2: Oh? Perintah baru datang... Pendekatan tempur ini... benar-benar memercayai kemampuan kita.

column1: What do you say, lend a hand and cooperate to complete this set of orders?
column2: Bagaimana, mau bantu dan bekerja sama menuntaskan rangkaian perintah ini?

column1: ...If you hold me back, watch out for your wine cabinet.
column2: ...Kalau kau menghambatku, awas lemari anggurmu.

column1: (Asteria doesn't wait for Beluga's response at all. She raises her rifle and slowly advances towards the target defense line.)
column2: (Asteria sama sekali tidak menunggu jawaban Beluga. Dia mengangkat senapannya dan perlahan maju ke garis pertahanan sasaran.)

column1: (Her combat style is cold and precise. Every time she pulls the trigger, she is guaranteed to hit the target.)
column2: (Gaya tempurnya dingin dan presisi. Setiap kali dia menarik pelatuk, sasarannya dipastikan kena.)

column1: Hah, you really dare to say that.
column2: Hah, kau berani juga bicara begitu.

column1: Find them first before you talk.
column2: Temukan dulu lemarinya sebelum bicara.

column1: So you really hid a wine cellar while wandering around?
column2: Jadi kau memang menyembunyikan gudang anggur selama berkeliaran?

column1: ...You were actually tricking me into talking!?
column2: ...Kau ternyata memancingku bicara!?

column1: Wow... little sister is growing up way too fast.
column2: Wah... anak kecil ini tumbuhnya terlalu cepat.

column1: (Click-clack—)
column2: (Klik-klak—)

column1: (The crisp sound of the slide locking back on an empty magazine was particularly jarring on the noisy battlefield, allowing the restless monsters to seize the opportunity to attack.)
column2: (Bunyi nyaring slide terkunci karena magasin kosong itu terasa sangat mengganggu di medan tempur yang riuh, membuat monster-monster yang gelisah itu mendapat kesempatan menyerang.)

column1: (A massive phantom had already swung its sharp claws towards Asteria's head.)
column2: (Sebuah fantom masif sudah mengayunkan cakarnya yang tajam ke arah kepala Asteria.)

column1: （哒哒哒——）
column2: （Tratata——）

column1: (The three-round burst from the burst fire passed over Asteria's shoulder from behind, easily piercing the phantom's head.)
column2: (Rentetan tiga proyektil dari mode tembak beruntun melewati bahu Asteria dari belakang, dengan mudah menembus kepala fantom itu.)

column1: Tactical Formation B, alternating fire.
column2: Formasi Taktis B, tembakan bergantian.

column1: (In this split second, Asteria has already completed an extremely smooth tactical reload.)
column2: (Dalam sekejap itu, Asteria sudah menyelesaikan isi ulang taktis yang sangat mulus.)

column1: (The two cooperating on the battlefield don't even need eye contact. Sometimes alternating fire, sometimes covering back-to-back, they execute tactical movements like precision gears, methodically pushing the frontline forward under the watch of the blue butterflies.)
column2: (Keduanya yang bekerja sama di medan tempur bahkan tidak butuh kontak mata. Sesekali menembak bergantian, sesekali melindungi punggung-ke-punggung, mereka menjalankan gerakan taktis seperti roda gigi presisi, mendorong garis depan maju dengan tertib di bawah pengawasan kupu-kupu biru itu.)

column1: Commander, all coordinates confirmed, everyone has acknowledged the orders.
column2: Commander, semua koordinat terkonfirmasi, semuanya sudah menerima perintahnya.

column1: Soppo is 3, 2, 1 away from contacting the target...
column2: Soppo 3, 2, 1 lagi sebelum menyentuh sasaran...

column1: Communication confirmed, contact with the target has been made.
column2: Komunikasi terkonfirmasi, kontak dengan sasaran sudah terjadi.

column1: (Kaboom—)
column2: (Duarrr—)

column1: (Muffled explosions and the roars of a giant beast come from the distant battlefield, a signal that Soppo and the others are engaging the target.)
column2: (Dentuman teredam dan raungan binatang raksasa datang dari medan tempur di kejauhan, tanda Soppo dan yang lain sudah bersinggungan dengan sasaran.)

column1: I have finished confirming their combat data. Next, let me borrow your power to verify it.
column2: Aku sudah selesai memastikan data tempur mereka. Berikutnya, izinkan aku meminjam kekuatanmu untuk memverifikasinya.

column1: (Faint blue streams of light rise around M4A1, transforming into countless shimmering blue butterflies. In this scarlet, deathly still space of Nirvana, they trace out intricate and beautiful trajectories.)
column2: (Aliran cahaya biru samar naik di sekitar M4A1, berubah menjadi kupu-kupu biru berkilau yang tak terhitung. Di ruang Nirvana yang merah menyala dan sunyi mati itu, mereka melukis lintasan yang rumit dan indah.)

column1: Links and anchors... Soppo, Asteria, Beluga, Robella...
column2: Tautan dan jangkar... Soppo, Asteria, Beluga, Robella...

column1: Mhm, everyone is there. Confirming relative positions and event interference—
column2: Mhm, semuanya ada. Memastikan posisi relatif dan interferensi peristiwa—
（Prang——）

column1: (A crisp sound like shattering glass echoed through the entire space, just like when I first stepped into Nirvana. The space was forcefully folded and distorted.)
column2: (Bunyi nyaring seperti kaca pecah bergaung di seluruh ruang itu, sama seperti saat aku pertama melangkah ke Nirvana. Ruangnya dilipat dan dipuntir dengan paksa.)

column1: Whoa?! We really got pulled over with a 'whoosh'! M4 is amazing!
column2: Wah?! Kami benar-benar ditarik dengan 'wush'! M4 luar biasa!

column1: Is this M16's Reverse Collapse or whatever! I want to learn too!
column2: Ini Reverse Collapse-nya M16 atau apa itu! Aku juga mau belajar!

column1: (The light dissipated, and the three mountain-sized phantoms that were originally wreaking havoc in the distance, along with the other four members of the AR Team, were instantly and forcefully teleported right in front of me and M4A1.)
column2: (Cahayanya hilang, dan tiga fantom sebesar gunung yang tadinya mengamuk di kejauhan, bersama empat anggota AR Team lainnya, seketika dipindahkan secara paksa tepat ke depan aku dan M4A1.)

column1: (Gathering scattered strong enemies to a single point, this is an annihilation operation planned using the fastest and shortest method.)
column2: (Mengumpulkan musuh kuat yang tersebar ke satu titik, ini operasi pemusnahan yang dirancang dengan metode tercepat dan terpendek.)

column1: (This group of frenzied behemoths clearly sensed the lethal threat emanating from M4A1. They immediately abandoned their original opponents, turned their massive bodies, and locked their murderous gazes firmly on me and M4A1.)
column2: (Gerombolan raksasa yang mengamuk itu jelas merasakan ancaman mematikan yang memancar dari M4A1. Mereka langsung meninggalkan lawan awalnya, memutar tubuh masifnya, dan mengunci tatapan membunuhnya pada aku dan M4A1.)

column1: (But just as they were about to pounce, three scorching tongues of fire lit up simultaneously from different directions, accurately hitting their eyes and the weak spots on their bodies.)
column2: (Tapi tepat saat mereka hendak menerjang, tiga lidah api membara menyala serentak dari arah yang berbeda, tepat mengenai mata dan titik lemah di tubuh mereka.)

column1: Where are you looking! Don't you like the new look I prepared for you!
column2: Kau lihat ke mana! Tidak suka penampilan baru yang kusiapkan untukmu!

column1: Suppressive fire ready, they can't move.
column2: Tembakan penekan siap, mereka tidak bisa bergerak.

column1: Asteria, open fire.
column2: Asteria, tembak.

column1: (A white light of destruction instantly tore through the gloom of the battlefield.)
column2: (Cahaya putih kehancuran seketika mencabik kepekatan medan tempur itu.)

column1: (The "Avenger's Mark" in Asteria's hands let out a deafening roar. The energy-gathering railgun pierced through the throats of three large phantoms simultaneously without any resistance, instantly evaporating their massive bodies into a sky full of ashes.)
column2: ("Avenger's Mark" di tangan Asteria melepas raungan yang memekakkan. Railgun pengumpul energi itu menembus tenggorokan tiga fantom besar sekaligus tanpa hambatan, seketika menguapkan tubuh masif mereka jadi langit penuh abu.)

column1: Target annihilated, confirmed.
column2: Sasaran musnah, terkonfirmasi.

column1: Phew... the door has stabilized. Good work, everyone.
column2: Fyuh... pintunya sudah stabil. Kerja bagus, semuanya.

column1: (Almost at the exact same moment the giant phantoms were defeated, M4A1 completed the repair of the Nirvana loophole. The AR Team also quickly dispersed, sweeping away the remaining scattered phantoms on the battlefield like autumn wind sweeping away fallen leaves.)
column2: (Nyaris di saat yang sama ketika fantom raksasa itu dikalahkan, M4A1 menyelesaikan penambalan celah Nirvana. AR Team juga cepat berpencar, menyapu fantom sisa yang berserak di medan tempur seperti angin gugur menyapu daun kering.)

column1: (Although the world of Nirvana is still permeated with the smell of gunpowder smoke, the creatures born from the remnants of phenomena no longer flood into this space.)
column2: (Meski dunia Nirvana masih dipenuhi bau asap mesiu, makhluk yang lahir dari sisa fenomena itu tidak lagi membanjiri ruang ini.)

column1: Heeheehee, I'm really so happy. It's been a long time since I fought this refreshingly.
column2: Hihihi, aku benar-benar senang. Sudah lama aku tidak bertarung selega ini.

column1: Is it necessary to be so exaggerated?
column2: Perlu sampai selebay itu?

column1: Of course it's necessary! This is a battle with all members of the AR Team! I've been looking forward to this day for a long time!
column2: Tentu perlu! Ini pertempuran dengan seluruh anggota AR Team! Aku sudah lama menantikan hari ini!

column1: With the Commander and M4's tactical command!
column2: Dengan komando taktis Commander dan M4!

column1: With RO always by my side providing support.
column2: Dengan RO yang selalu di sisiku memberi dukungan.

column1: I have M16 to help me solve all my problems. And your cover fire, 15!
column2: Ada M16 yang membantu menyelesaikan semua masalahku. Dan tembakan perlindunganmu, 15!

column1: Soppo, if you hug me as hard as you hug them, I might not be able to take it.
column2: Soppo, kalau kau memelukku sekuat kau memeluk mereka, aku mungkin tidak sanggup.

column1: (Looking at Soppo, whose eyes were shining with excitement, I hurriedly reached out before she could launch her "Doll Self-Propelled Headbutt Missile" and vigorously rubbed her messy long hair as a reward for her excellent performance.)
column2: (Menatap Soppo yang matanya berkilau penuh semangat, aku buru-buru mengulurkan tangan sebelum dia melepaskan "Misil Sundulan Gerak Sendiri Doll"-nya, lalu mengacak-acak keras rambut panjangnya yang berantakan sebagai hadiah atas penampilannya yang luar biasa.)

column1: (And she leaned against me with a look of enjoyment, relishing this reward.)
column2: (Dan dia bersandar padaku dengan wajah menikmati, meresapi hadiah itu.)

column1: Phase one of the battle is over. As the first battle after the AR Team's reorganization, your performance was impeccable.
column2: Fase satu pertempuran selesai. Sebagai pertempuran pertama setelah AR Team disusun ulang, penampilan kalian tanpa cela.

column1: Using yourself and M4 as bait, and heavily relying on M4's power in this world.
column2: Memakai dirimu dan M4 sebagai umpan, dan sangat mengandalkan kekuatan M4 di dunia ini.

column1: Not a single tactical armament was spared... as expected of the Commander.
column2: Tidak satu pun persenjataan taktis yang disisakan... memang Commander.

column1: Yeah, just as Soppo said... being able to fight together with everyone like this is indeed something from a long time ago.
column2: Iya, seperti kata Soppo... bisa bertarung bersama semuanya seperti ini memang hal dari waktu yang lama sekali.

column1: Aren't you going to quickly state your position?
column2: Kau tidak mau cepat menyatakan sikapmu?

column1: Alright, alright, stop poking my back. Next time we drink together, I'll penalize myself with three cups first, okay?
column2: Sudah, sudah, berhenti menyodok punggungku. Lain kali saat kita minum bersama, aku hukum diriku tiga cangkir dulu, ya?

column1: However, even though it's the same squad, everyone's combat style has still undergone some subtle changes.
column2: Namun meski regunya sama, gaya tempur semuanya tetap mengalami sedikit perubahan.

column1: Especially someone—it seems you're using that 'new toy' very handily.
column2: Terutama seseorang—sepertinya kau memakai 'mainan baru' itu dengan sangat cekatan.

column1: ...At least it's much more valuable than hanging on you as a decoration.
column2: ...Setidaknya jauh lebih berharga dari sekadar tergantung di tubuhmu sebagai hiasan.

column1: (Asteria retorts coldly, while carefully checking the cooling module of the 'Mark of the Avenger'. After confirming the firearm is in good condition, she skillfully stows this heavy weapon back into its box form.)
column2: (Asteria membalas dengan dingin, sembari memeriksa dengan teliti modul pendingin 'Mark of the Avenger'. Setelah memastikan senjatanya dalam kondisi baik, dia dengan cekatan menyimpan senjata berat itu kembali ke bentuk kotaknya.)

column1: But regarding this weapon... next time you give a gift, remember to come to me in person.
column2: Tapi soal senjata ini... lain kali kalau memberi hadiah, ingat datang sendiri padaku.

column1: Wouldn't it be better to be a bit more frank at a time like this?
column2: Bukannya lebih baik sedikit lebih terus terang di saat seperti ini?

column1: You don't understand, she's super happy right now.
column2: Kau tidak paham, dia sekarang senang sekali.

column1: Ouch... why did you hit me?
column2: Aduh... kenapa aku dipukul?

column1: Shut up.
column2: Tutup mulut.

column1: Thank you for being willing to fight with it.
column2: Terima kasih sudah mau bertarung dengannya.

column1: As a weapon, it is impeccable.
column2: Sebagai senjata, dia tanpa cela.

column1: It can help me eliminate the enemies I want to destroy, and allow me to protect the people I want to protect. That's all. So, put away that apologetic expression of yours, M4.
column2: Dia bisa membantuku melenyapkan musuh yang ingin kuhancurkan, dan memungkinkanku melindungi orang yang ingin kulindungi. Itu saja. Jadi, simpan ekspresi minta maafmu itu, M4.

column1: Robella is right. At a time like this, you should just properly say that you want to protect the world you and the Commander once protected together.
column2: Robella benar. Di saat seperti ini, kau seharusnya mengatakan dengan benar bahwa kau ingin melindungi dunia yang pernah kau dan Commander lindungi bersama.

column1: *Cough cough*... I didn't say anything.
column2: *Uhuk uhuk*... Aku tidak bilang apa-apa.

column1: AR-15, thank you so much.
column2: AR-15, terima kasih banyak.

column1: You really still don't understand. I don't need the word 'thanks.'
column2: Kau benar-benar masih belum paham. Aku tidak butuh kata 'terima kasih.'

column1: Whether it's me, the Commander, Soppo, Robella, or M16... what we want to hear most isn't 'thanks.'
column2: Baik aku, Commander, Soppo, Robella, maupun M16... yang paling ingin kami dengar bukan 'terima kasih.'

column1: I understand, but I...
column2: Aku paham, tapi aku...

column1: I said you don't understand.
column2: Kubilang kau tidak paham.

column1: (Asteria walked up to M4A1, her gaze as sharp and merciless as when I first saw them reunite.)
column2: (Asteria melangkah ke arah M4A1, tatapannya setajam dan sekejam saat pertama kali kulihat mereka bertemu kembali.)

column1: (But the emotions and wishes in her words were slightly different from the past.)
column2: (Tapi emosi dan keinginan dalam kata-katanya sedikit berbeda dari dulu.)

column1: Listen well, M4.
column2: Dengar baik-baik, M4.

column1: Regardless of identity, regardless of mission, regardless of time, regardless of space.
column2: Tidak peduli identitas, tidak peduli misi, tidak peduli waktu, tidak peduli ruang.

column1: We were born because of you. I don't consider this a burden, and I absolutely will not allow you or anyone else to unilaterally try to sever this connection.
column2: Kami lahir karena kau. Aku tidak menganggap itu beban, dan aku sama sekali tidak akan mengizinkanmu atau siapa pun memutus ikatan ini secara sepihak.

column1: Just like the battle just now. You will always be the AR Team's M4A1, our and the Commander's M4A1.
column2: Seperti pertempuran tadi. Kau akan selalu jadi M4A1 milik AR Team, M4A1 milik kami dan Commander.

column1: You should know better than anyone what response we want to hear the most.
column2: Kau seharusnya lebih tahu dari siapa pun jawaban apa yang paling ingin kami dengar.

column1: No need to rush to give an answer now.
column2: Tidak perlu buru-buru menjawab sekarang.

column1: (Asteria turned slightly, making room behind her. There, Soppo was grinning foolishly, Robella crossed her arms with a firm gaze, and Beluga waved in greeting from afar.)
column2: (Asteria berbalik sedikit, membuka ruang di belakangnya. Di sana Soppo tersenyum lebar dengan bodohnya, Robella menyilangkan tangan dengan tatapan mantap, dan Beluga melambai memberi salam dari jauh.)

column1: (And I stood right in the middle of them.)
column2: (Dan aku berdiri tepat di tengah mereka.)

column1: We will wait for you. We are willing to believe, and willing to wait together for the day you truly say those words.
column2: Kami akan menunggumu. Kami bersedia percaya, dan bersedia menunggu bersama hari ketika kau benar-benar mengucapkan kata-kata itu.

column1: Everyone... Commander...
column2: Semuanya... Commander...

column1: Asteria is right. We are willing to believe, and we can wait together.
column2: Asteria benar. Kami bersedia percaya, dan kami bisa menunggu bersama.

column1: I am willing to fight alongside you, with every single one of you.
column2: Aku bersedia bertarung bersamamu, bersama setiap orang dari kalian.

column1: So, everyone—
column2: Jadi, semuanya—

column1: (Pulling a brand new magazine from her tactical vest, she pushes it into her sidearm with a crisp metallic click.)
column2: (Menarik magasin yang benar-benar baru dari rompi taktisnya, dia memasukkannya ke pistolnya dengan bunyi logam yang nyaring.)

column1: (My gaze swept over every Doll present, finally looking toward the end of the abyss where the girl named Ateraxis had disappeared.)
column2: (Tatapanku menyapu setiap Doll yang ada di situ, lalu akhirnya tertuju ke ujung jurang tempat gadis bernama Ateraxis menghilang.)

column1: (Click—)
column2: (Klik—)

column1: (The uniform sound of bolts being pulled echoed in the empty space. That was the most perfect answer they could give me.)
column2: (Bunyi kokang ditarik secara serentak bergaung di ruang yang kosong itu. Itulah jawaban paling sempurna yang bisa mereka berikan padaku.)

column1: Let's move out, AR Team. Prepare for the second phase of the operation.
column2: Bergerak, AR Team. Bersiap untuk fase kedua operasi.

column1: (In front of her, there was no "door" as Chiloveig had described, only two distinct, infinitely extending existences that could even encompass the entire universe.)
column2: (Di depannya tidak ada "pintu" seperti yang digambarkan Chiloveig, hanya dua eksistensi berbeda yang memanjang tanpa batas dan bahkan bisa memuat seluruh alam semesta.)

column1: (One is the crimson left behind her, and the other is the holy pure white before her eyes.)
column2: (Satu adalah merah tua yang dia tinggalkan di belakang, dan satu lagi putih murni yang suci di depan matanya.)

column1: Lunasia... you're rejecting me?
column2: Lunasia... kau menolakku?

column1: Then, please excuse my rudeness.
column2: Kalau begitu, maafkan kelancanganku.

column1: (Ateraxis stepped forward as if accepting a challenge.)
column2: (Ateraxis melangkah maju seolah menerima sebuah tantangan.)

column1: (Then, she felt as if she was endlessly spinning high above the sky. This was already Nirvana. She had stepped into the place where 'gods' once played and observed. No matter how powerful she was in the original world, here, she felt she was merely an imperceptibly small existence in a drop of water in the endless pure white sea.)
column2: (Lalu dia merasa seolah berputar tanpa henti tinggi di atas langit. Ini sudah Nirvana. Dia sudah melangkah ke tempat tempat 'para dewa' pernah bermain dan mengamati. Sekuat apa pun dia di dunia asalnya, di sini dia merasa dirinya hanya eksistensi yang teramat kecil dalam setetes air di lautan putih murni tanpa ujung.)

column1: (A part of her self within her body resisted this space. That unprecedented stinging pain made her comprehend a brand new instinct for the first time since her birth—a sense of unease.)
column2: (Sebagian dari dirinya di dalam tubuhnya melawan ruang ini. Nyeri menusuk yang belum pernah dia rasakan itu membuatnya memahami satu insting yang benar-benar baru untuk pertama kali sejak dia lahir—rasa gelisah.)

column1: (She was not accepted, not permitted, and thus bore a sin and was about to be punished. No matter how strong her physical body was, it absolutely could not withstand such punishment. Similarly, those sharp senses were no longer effective. Ateraxis heard a large amount of whispering, which also sounded like chanting—but it was not among the hundreds of languages she had mastered.)
column2: (Dia tidak diterima, tidak diizinkan, sehingga menanggung dosa dan akan dihukum. Sekuat apa pun tubuh fisiknya, itu sama sekali tidak bisa menahan hukuman seperti itu. Sama halnya, panca indera yang tajam itu tidak lagi berguna. Ateraxis mendengar bisikan dalam jumlah besar, yang juga terdengar seperti lantunan—tapi itu bukan salah satu dari ratusan bahasa yang dia kuasai.)

column1: (Countless hands were tearing at her body, while electric currents, extreme heat, and freezing cold took turns stimulating her nerves. This torture forced her to gradually shut down all her senses, reverting to a newborn state floating in amniotic fluid, wrapped in the membrane of the world.)
column2: (Tangan-tangan yang tak terhitung mencabik tubuhnya, sementara arus listrik, panas ekstrem, dan dingin membekukan bergantian merangsang sarafnya. Siksaan itu memaksanya berangsur mematikan seluruh panca inderanya, kembali ke keadaan bayi baru lahir yang mengapung di air ketuban, terbungkus membran dunia.)

column1: (Here, she was both fragile and blind.)
column2: (Di sini, dia rapuh sekaligus buta.)

column1: Touch, smell, taste, hearing, sight, sense of hot and cold, sense of balance, sense of space... sense of electric fields, sense of magnetic fields... It's not these senses. To understand this world, adhering to the laws of physics will actually be a hindrance.
column2: Sentuhan, penciuman, rasa, pendengaran, penglihatan, rasa panas dan dingin, rasa keseimbangan, rasa ruang... rasa medan listrik, rasa medan magnet... Bukan indera-indera itu. Untuk memahami dunia ini, berpegang pada hukum fisika justru jadi penghalang.

column1: I see. The "evolution" I have accumulated so far is completely meaningless here. The fact that I can even maintain this sense of self is because I carry the human genes of Mother—Caldwell.
column2: Begitu. "Evolusi" yang kukumpulkan sejauh ini sama sekali tidak berarti di sini. Bahkan aku bisa mempertahankan kesadaran diri ini karena aku membawa gen manusia Mother—Caldwell.

column1: I have to start over. The cells that make up my body will be accepted, which means Nirvana itself doesn't reject me. It's just that I can't understand all this. Right, just like her—
column2: Aku harus mulai dari awal. Sel-sel yang menyusun tubuhku akan diterima, artinya Nirvana sendiri tidak menolakku. Hanya saja aku tidak bisa memahami semua ini. Benar, sama seperti dia—

column1: (Ateraxis recalls that by "his" side, there was also such a Doll, a creation from when Mother first came into contact with Nirvana. Although she could listen to the voice of Nirvana, she could only understand fragments of it with a specialized Frame.)
column2: (Ateraxis mengingat bahwa di sisi "dia" juga ada Doll semacam itu, ciptaan dari masa Mother pertama bersentuhan dengan Nirvana. Meski dia bisa mendengarkan suara Nirvana, dia hanya bisa memahami pecahannya dengan Frame khusus.)

column1: (And Ateraxis also needed a form and existence that could fully adapt to Nirvana.)
column2: (Dan Ateraxis juga butuh bentuk dan eksistensi yang bisa sepenuhnya menyesuaikan diri dengan Nirvana.)

column1: I have to discard it. Let go of everything I've learned so far, and evolve a new body capable of surviving in Nirvana.
column2: Aku harus membuangnya. Melepas semua yang kupelajari sejauh ini, dan mengevolusikan tubuh baru yang mampu bertahan di Nirvana.

column1: The conclusion is clear, it's just...
column2: Kesimpulannya jelas, hanya saja...

column1: I... don't want to discard myself.
column2: Aku... tidak ingin membuang diriku sendiri.

column1: (Ateraxis was very insistent on her own existence. For this reason, she rejected the path arranged by Mother—refusing to devour any third-generation Dolls or merge with any consciousness, simply because she instinctively repulsed any 'impure' things that would interfere with her thoughts.)
column2: (Ateraxis sangat keras memegang eksistensinya sendiri. Karena itu dia menolak jalan yang diatur Mother—menolak menelan Doll generasi ketiga mana pun atau melebur dengan kesadaran apa pun, semata karena secara insting dia menampik hal 'tidak murni' yang akan mengganggu pikirannya.)

column1: (But if she wants to achieve her original goal now, if she wants to see 'Lunasia' and gain the qualification to speak with her, she has no other choice.)
column2: (Tapi kalau sekarang dia ingin mencapai tujuan awalnya, kalau dia ingin menemui 'Lunasia' dan mendapat kelayakan untuk berbicara dengannya, dia tidak punya pilihan lain.)

column1: ...I'm not resigned to this, I'm so scared... this fear accompanied by uncertainty...
column2: ...Aku tidak rela, aku sangat takut... rasa takut yang disertai ketidakpastian ini...

column1: So, so this is what it feels like to be alive.
column2: Jadi, jadi begini rasanya hidup.

column1: It's what Mother called the destiny of living creatures.
column2: Inilah yang Mother sebut takdir makhluk hidup.

column1: (She understood what "Mother" Caldwell had once said: "unfreedom" is the essence of life's struggle, and that is the root of why the mind grows strong.)
column2: (Dia memahami apa yang pernah dikatakan "Mother" Caldwell: "ketidakbebasan" adalah inti pergulatan kehidupan, dan itulah akar mengapa pikiran menjadi kuat.)

column1: (Life was initially confined to the water, but gradually advanced towards the land beneath the atmosphere. At some point, it conquered the sky, then honed its intelligence, and could even leave behind the planet that nurtured it.)
column2: (Kehidupan awalnya terkurung di air, tapi berangsur maju ke darat di bawah atmosfer. Pada satu titik ia menaklukkan langit, lalu mengasah kecerdasannya, dan bahkan bisa meninggalkan planet yang membesarkannya.)

column1: (But for an individual, facing a world that is always changing and requires one to adapt, facing the inevitable end that will eventually come, how unsettling must that be? Since her birth, Ateraxis finally understood such feelings.)
column2: (Tapi bagi satu individu, menghadapi dunia yang selalu berubah dan menuntut penyesuaian, menghadapi akhir yang pasti akan datang, betapa menggelisahkannya itu? Sejak dia lahir, Ateraxis akhirnya memahami perasaan semacam itu.)

column1: (At the same time, another thought crossed her mind.)
column2: (Pada waktu yang sama, satu pikiran lain melintas di kepalanya.)

column1: (Ateraxis briefly recalled their encounter at that time, the human who rashly intruded when she was bored in the empty castle.)
column2: (Ateraxis sekilas mengingat perjumpaan mereka waktu itu, manusia yang menyusup gegabah saat dia sedang bosan di kastel yang kosong.)

column1: (Facing a situation with no chance of winning, that human not only stood up to face it, but even wanted to protect those Dolls who were stronger than him.)
column2: (Menghadapi situasi tanpa peluang menang, manusia itu bukan cuma berdiri menghadapinya, tapi bahkan ingin melindungi Doll-Doll yang lebih kuat darinya.)

column1: (Incomprehensible, but... also impossible to look away.)
column2: (Tidak bisa dipahami, tapi... juga tidak mungkin dialihkan pandangan.)

column1: So fragile... so brave.
column2: Begitu rapuh... begitu berani.

column1: (Her fingertips gently touched her lips, which had once recorded the taste of this human's blood. That was the first behavior resembling biological "eating" for Ateraxis, who had absorbed countless Boojums to clothe herself.)
column2: (Ujung jarinya menyentuh lembut bibirnya, yang pernah merekam rasa darah manusia itu. Itulah perilaku pertama yang menyerupai "makan" secara biologis bagi Ateraxis, yang menyerap Boojum tak terhitung untuk membalut dirinya.)

column1: (For some reason, even in the Nirvana space, the burning sensation in her chest was so distinct.)
column2: (Entah kenapa, bahkan di ruang Nirvana, rasa membara di dadanya terasa begitu jelas.)

column1: (After encountering the Commander, she gradually developed respect for humans, whom she had previously dismissed.)
column2: (Setelah berjumpa dengan Commander, dia berangsur menumbuhkan rasa hormat pada manusia, yang sebelumnya dia remehkan.)

column1: Is that what it feels like to be alive?
column2: Jadi begitu rasanya hidup?

column1: Burning recklessly within a limited lifespan, a will that should fear death repeatedly stepping into the turbulent currents of death, one life after another advancing wave upon wave for an unreachable height.
column2: Membara tanpa perhitungan dalam usia yang terbatas, kehendak yang seharusnya takut mati berulang kali melangkah ke arus kematian yang bergejolak, satu nyawa demi satu nyawa maju gelombang demi gelombang demi ketinggian yang tak terjangkau.

column1: So beautiful... although small and fragile, it's very beautiful. Like the Commander, composing a beautiful poem in a world that is gradually slipping out of their control... I want to do that too.
column2: Begitu indah... meski kecil dan rapuh, itu sangat indah. Seperti Commander, menyusun puisi yang indah di dunia yang berangsur lepas dari kendalinya... aku juga ingin melakukannya.

column1: (It was from that moment that Ateraxis developed a "desire.")
column2: (Sejak saat itulah Ateraxis menumbuhkan sebuah "hasrat.")

column1: (Originally, from the beginning of her birth, she only wanted to get close to that 'perfect' creation, destined to open the door to 'Nirvana' after becoming the apex of the world.)
column2: (Semula, sejak awal kelahirannya, dia hanya ingin mendekati ciptaan 'sempurna' itu, yang ditakdirkan membuka pintu ke 'Nirvana' setelah menjadi puncak dunia.)

column1: (Whether this was a homing instinct or something else, she wasn't clear. As the ultimate Holy Grail created by Caldwell to conquer Nirvana and become the deity of the new era, she merely accepted this 'mission'.)
column2: (Apakah itu insting pulang ke sarang atau sesuatu yang lain, dia tidak jelas. Sebagai Holy Grail pamungkas yang diciptakan Caldwell untuk menaklukkan Nirvana dan menjadi dewa era baru, dia hanya menerima 'misi' itu.)

column1: (But after meeting the Commander, the motive to see Lunasia became blurred.)
column2: (Tapi setelah bertemu Commander, motif untuk menemui Lunasia jadi kabur.)

column1: (Compared to the final result, the process seems to have become more important. Compared to achieving this result, "for what purpose" seems to be more important.)
column2: (Dibanding hasil akhirnya, prosesnya seolah jadi lebih penting. Dibanding mencapai hasil itu, "untuk tujuan apa" seolah jadi lebih penting.)

column1: —If "you" can continue moving forward without fearing your own demise, then I can too.
column2: —Kalau "kau" bisa terus melangkah maju tanpa menakuti kematianmu sendiri, aku juga bisa.

column1: If you can abandon your unique self for the sake of an ideal, I will show you that I can do it too.
column2: Kalau kau bisa meninggalkan dirimu yang unik demi sebuah cita-cita, akan kutunjukkan bahwa aku juga bisa.

column1: I won't lose to you.
column2: Aku tidak akan kalah darimu.

column1: I will not lose to humans.
column2: Aku tidak akan kalah dari manusia.

column1: Please do not go any further.
column2: Tolong jangan melangkah lebih jauh.

column1: (The myriad chanting voices fell silent, and she heard a voice behind her—the speaker had not existed here a moment ago, simply because in Nirvana, movement does not rely on feet or vehicles, but on one's own will.)
column2: (Lantunan suara yang tak terhitung itu terdiam, dan dia mendengar sebuah suara di belakangnya—pemilik suara itu sesaat lalu tidak ada di sini, semata karena di Nirvana gerakan tidak bergantung pada kaki atau kendaraan, tapi pada kehendak sendiri.)

column1: (Black hair fluttering melodiously, a beautiful young Doll—the shadow of Lunasia could faintly be seen on her face. That was the soul of the AR Team, and also a fragment of Lunasia.)
column2: (Rambut hitam yang berkibar merdu, seorang Doll muda yang cantik—bayangan Lunasia terlihat samar di wajahnya. Itu adalah jiwa AR Team, dan juga sepotong pecahan Lunasia.)

column1: You are Lunasia?
column2: Kau Lunasia?

column1: (Ateraxis revealed an unprecedentedly bright smile and turned to the pursuers behind her.)
column2: (Ateraxis memperlihatkan senyum paling cerah yang belum pernah ada dan berbalik ke para pengejar di belakangnya.)

column1: (She was even a bit shy and constrained, like a clumsy girl stepping into a social occasion for the first time.)
column2: (Dia bahkan tampak agak malu dan kaku, seperti gadis yang kikuk melangkah ke acara sosial untuk pertama kali.)

column1: Unfortunately, Ateraxis, I am not that person... and you don't have the qualifications to stay here either.
column2: Sayangnya, Ateraxis, aku bukan orang itu... dan kau juga tidak punya kelayakan untuk tinggal di sini.

column1: Could you please leave?
column2: Bisa tolong pergi?

column1: (Space distorts under her will. Ateraxis struggles forward, tearing apart the fog barrier binding her, and forcibly steps into the domain that rejects her.)
column2: (Ruang terpuntir di bawah kehendaknya. Ateraxis berjuang maju, mencabik tabir kabut yang membelenggunya, dan memaksa langkahnya masuk ke ranah yang menolaknya.)
